name: The Oaks Shopping Center
description: The Oaks Shopping Center is a premier enclosed regional mall serving the Conejo Valley and Ventura County communities. Anchored by Macy's, JCPenney, and Sears, this expansive shopping destination offers a diverse mix of national retailers, specialty boutiques, dining options, and entertainment venues. Located in the heart of Thousand Oaks, The Oaks has been a cornerstone of the community since 1978, providing a comfortable climate-controlled shopping experience with ample parking and family-friendly amenities.
demographics: Serves affluent Conejo Valley families with median household incomes exceeding $100,000, drawing shoppers from Thousand Oaks, Westlake Village, and surrounding Ventura County communities.
summary: A prominent regional mall in Thousand Oaks featuring major department stores, national retailers, and dining options serving the Conejo Valley community.
